scope: kyoku where LuckyJ is not dealer; LuckyJ's own discard number 1..18; own-riichi states excluded

definitions.safe: held tile class already present in at least one opponent's river at decision time
definitions.quiet: no opponent riichi and no opponent with 2+ melds
definitions.kept_safe_cut_live: among turns holding at least one safe class, share where the discard was not in any opponent river
definitions.floater: held singleton with no same-suit neighbor within two ranks; dragons, own seat wind and round wind excluded
definitions.naga: Nishiki head top pick, dahai_pred[0], at the same decision
definitions.by_kind: same comparison restricted to turns holding a safe and a live floater of the same kind (honor, terminal, middle), which removes tile-type composition
definitions.floater_choice: turns holding at least one safe floater and one live floater: which kind LuckyJ discarded, against the safe share of floaters as the indifference baseline

summary_bands.definition: same-kind floater pairs, one safe and one live; live_share_pct = share of cuts of either tile that went to the live one

summary_turns.definition: per discard: k = choices where the live leftover was thrown (the safe one kept), n = choices of either leftover; percentages are 100 k / n
summary_turns.method: binomial logistic regression on a natural cubic spline of the discard number, 1 to 3 degrees of freedom chosen by AIC, fitted over the longest run of discards with at least 10 choices each; the 95% band uses the covariance scaled by max(1, Pearson dispersion)
